name: @pipeworx/mcp-missouri-code

tools.name: mo_revised_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Missouri Revised Statutes — Missouri state law — by citation. "RSMo 565.020" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Mo. Rev. Stat. 565.020 say" or to check a statute a case relies on.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-missouri-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the missouri-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
